findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout_link, search_site · Public sink: cloudcost_start_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout_link, search_site · Public sink: cloudcost_start_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "cloudcost_audit_csv" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
